title: 태엽 도시
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished story-stage landscape illustration, without any title or lettering. Opaque wide 16:9 at the largest available landscape resolution, intended for downscaling to 640x360 and display at 360-480px width. Reference 1 is the game's painted pixel-art style anchor; reference 2 is its story painting style; reference 3 is this realm's palette, architecture and landmarks. All are reference inputs, not edit targets. Match the crisp visible painted pixel clusters and stepped silhouettes, rich but controlled colour, layered fantasy depth; no photographic or smooth 3D rendering. Cohesive nine-picture set rules: wide level establishing view, one dominant landmark centred horizontally in the MIDDLE THIRD, skyline/horizon around 70-74% image height in the LOWER THIRD, key environmental light from UPPER LEFT, midtone readability with dark blue-violet shadows, moderate saturation and contrast comparable to the other realms. Simple large shapes readable in a thumbnail. The outermost 3% on every side must be low-detail calm scenery safe for an 8px frame overlap, but DO NOT draw a frame. Keep the entire landmark in view. No people, human faces, humanoid figures, statues, letters, text-like decoration, glyphs, runes, numerals, logo, watermark, UI, borders or frames. No text anywhere. Stage 4, take A. SVARTALFHEIM: the DWARVEN CLOCKWORK CITY, entirely empty of people. A central massive forge tower with two huge exposed BRASS GEARS, a visible orange FORGE GLOW in its open furnace, and TWO CONVEYOR BELTS with broad V-shaped CHEVRON TREADS physically built into the belts. The chevrons are machine tread geometry only, no standalone written arrows or signs. Take A: wide frontal city panorama across a dark teal cavern, one huge round gear silhouetted behind the central angular forge tower, interlocking smaller gear beside it; horizontal belts approach the furnace from the sides in lower third. Distant factory floor/fog horizon at y72%, cavern opens tall above; upper-left fissure sends pale warm light down-left-facing metal. Steel blue, dark teal, brass and amber palette of reference. Simplify outlying buildings, no clock face, numerals, runes, signs or inhabitants. LAYOUT PRIORITY over the reference compositions: references supply style and realm identity only. Do NOT repeat their tall busy edge islands or high skyline. Keep the distant horizon unmistakably at y=75% of frame height, leaving the top 70% broad quiet atmospheric space interrupted only by the SINGLE central landmark. All secondary distant ground details remain below y=70%. No elaborate foreground objects at the edges. Main landmark base at y=76%, top near y=28%, visual centre x=50%. Calm outer 8 pixels after downscale.
